ev.q: Complete results of the systematic review and meta-analysis have been published elsewhere
Approximately 5% of persons discontinue 3HP because of adverse events
CDC continues to recommend 3HP for treatment of LTBI in adults
A CDC Work Group including epidemiologists, health scientists, physicians from CDC’s Tuberculosis Elimination program

methods_quotes.q: The library specialist used a systematic search strategy to identify and retrieve intervention studies on the use of 3HP to treat LTBI
Two reviewers from the CDC Work Group independently screened citations obtained from the search
Each study was also assessed for threats to internal and external validity per Guide to Community Preventive Services standards
Any disagreement between reviewers was resolved by consensus of the CDC Work Group members.
